title: The Parts Velocity Vendor filter ticks, selects all and clears
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · a production sign-in for the comparison · about 10 minutes. No test data of its own.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List. Your role must see Reports.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Before you start: Reports > Parts Velocity; if the Vendor filter was changed, set it back to its default.
  • For step 9: a sign-in to production (app.shopview.com) that can see Reports. You only look there; nothing is changed.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top menu.
  2. In the PARTS group click "Parts Velocity".
  3. Open the Vendor filter. Note that "All vendors" is ticked.
  4. Click one option. Write down what happens to the ticks and to the report.
  5. Click the same option again. Write down what happens.
  6. Click the "All vendors" box. Write down what happens; if it is already ticked, click it once more and write that down too.
  7. Look for a Clear selection button (write down whether there is one, and its words). If there is one, click it and write down what happens.
  8. Close the filter and set Vendor back to "All vendors".
  9. In another browser tab sign in to production (app.shopview.com) and repeat steps 1 to 8 on the same report. Compare each step with what you wrote down.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every step behaves the same on this build as on production (step 9): the same ticks change, the report narrows and widens the same way, and the same buttons are offered.
  • Clicking an option changes which options are ticked, and the report updates to match. (Production today: with "All vendors" ticked, clicking an option selects only that option and the button reads "1 selected"; clicking it again goes back to "All vendors".)
  • "All vendors" ticks every option; clicking it while it is ticked unticks every option. (Production has no separate Clear selection button; clicking the ticked "All vendors" box clears the selection.)
  • No error message appears.
  • Mark Failed only if this build behaves differently from production in any step (QA lead's decision below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 7; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), hotspot 5; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead decision, 12 Oct 2026 (recorded on this test in run 498: https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/tests/view/3792555): this build behaves the same as production, so it passes; an issue that production has too is not a regression.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 7: “The filter option list now supports disabled options. Check that options toggle normally and that Select all and Clear selection work.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/10/2026; production compared by the QA lead on 10/12/2026.
